sector: Consumer discretionary — Automobiles (Jeep, Ram, Peugeot, Fiat and 10 other brands; North America, Europe, South America, Middle East & Africa)
research_status_text: Initial, after Q3 2026 results (2026-10-28) and a 67% fall in 2026 to a record low
stance_text: Own, small and high-variance. At $3.54 the market capitalization (about EUR 9.4B) is under 6% of revenue and prices AOI margins near 3% indefinitely; a partial recovery to 4.2% by 2029, below management's 5% for 2028, is worth about $6.59, and the probability-weighted $6.30 implies 21.2% a year over 3 years. A 35% bear case (margins stuck near 2%, no free cash flow, a junk rating) is worth about $1.25, so the position should be sized for a possible 65% loss.
lens_text: Value at December 31, 2029: FY2029 adjusted net income to common (AOI less net financial expense and a EUR 0.4-0.7B recurring allowance for restructuring, taxed at 27%, less hybrid coupons) per diluted share times an exit P/E (bear 4x, base 4x, bull 5.5x), plus dividends paid in 2028-2029, converted at EUR/USD 1.0972; undiscounted; cross-checked against 6.5x 2029 industrial free cash flow plus industrial net cash less the hybrid notes

bear.basis: Cost inflation (raw materials, memory chips) eats the Value Creation Program savings: AOI margin 1.2%/1.8%/2.3% in 2027-2029 on revenue of EUR 158-162B; IFCF -EUR 2.2B in 2027 (Oddo BHF's estimate), -EUR 1.0B in 2028, zero in 2029; a junk downgrade raises financing costs to EUR 1.0-1.2B and a further EUR 3B hybrid at 8% is issued in 2027; no dividends; 2029 adjusted EPS EUR 0.29 x 4x = EUR 1.14. On cash terms the equity is worth less than nothing (end-2029 industrial net cash EUR 6.7B against EUR 7.9B of hybrids and EUR 5.0B of benefit liabilities, with no free cash flow)

base.basis: A partial recovery that misses the FaSTLAne 2030 path: revenue EUR 164.5B/169.5B/175B (2028 plan EUR 175B), AOI margin 2.3% in 2027 (the Visible Alpha consensus), 3.6% in 2028 (plan 5%) and 4.2% in 2029, as about EUR 5B of further VCP savings are offset by about EUR 3B of cost inflation; IFCF 0 / EUR 1.5B / EUR 2.5B (plan: positive / EUR 3B / about EUR 4.5B); 27% payout from 2028; 2029 adjusted EPS EUR 1.39 x 4x (Stellantis's own 2.5-3.6x at peak earnings in 2022-2023, 6.8x on the depressed 2024; GM and Ford ten-year medians 6.4x and 6.7x) plus EUR 0.43 of dividends = EUR 6.01

bull.basis: The plan arrives about a year late: AOI margin 3.0%/4.6%/5.8% on revenue of EUR 167B/175B/183B, North America back to 8%+ on Ram, Jeep relaunches and the reopened Belvidere and Toledo lines; IFCF EUR 1.0B/3.0B/4.5B; 30% payout from 2028; 2029 adjusted EPS EUR 2.27 x 5.5x (below GM and Ford medians) plus EUR 0.74 of dividends = EUR 13.23

horizon_text: Value at December 31, 2029, undiscounted, plus dividends paid in 2028-2029; 3.1 years after the 2026-11-19 price, annualized over the rule's 3 years (21.2% a year; 20.3% over the actual 3.1 years)

street.rating_text: Hold (S&P Global consensus; in November 3 Strong Buy, 1 Hold, 2 Sell, 1 Strong Sell; Bloomberg: 4 buy, 20 hold, 7 sell of 31). Oddo BHF downgraded to Underperform (EUR 3.00) on 2026-11-17; Bank of America Sell $3.84; RBC Hold $3.29; UBS Hold $4.93; Barclays Hold $11
street.source: StockAnalysis (S&P Global, TipRanks), sources/stockanalysis-forecast-2026-11-20.html.gz; Bloomberg counts via Milano Finanza, sources/news-excerpts-2026-11-20.txt

deviation_from_street.reason: Close to the mean, for different reasons: Street targets are 12-month prices and most were cut 25-45% in November, while this is an end-2029 value whose base case sits below the Street's 2027 EPS (EUR 0.52 after a restructuring allowance against EUR 0.90 adjusted) and applies a 4x exit P/E.

thesis: Stellantis is priced at about EUR 9.4B, under 6% of revenue, as if adjusted operating margins stay near 3% for good; a recovery to 4.2% by 2029, below management's 5% for 2028 and about a third of the 2022-2023 operating margin, gives 2029 adjusted EPS of about EUR 1.39, worth about $6.59 at 4x with dividends, and $6.30 after weighting a 35% chance that cost inflation and cash burn keep margins near 2%.
consensus_view: After a 67% fall in 2026 to a record low, the market treats the EUR 22B of 2025 charges, the EUR 4.0B Q3 cash burn, heavy short interest (9.1% of capital) and the CEO's warning of 'billions' of raw-material and memory-chip inflation in 2027-2028 as proof the FaSTLAne 2030 targets are unreachable; Oddo BHF expects 2027 IFCF of -EUR 2.2B and a 1.6% margin, and the Street has cut targets to a $6.39 mean with a Hold rating.
variant_view: The market is pricing an AOI margin of roughly 2.5-3.1% held indefinitely (at 4-5.6x earnings): a modest step up from 2026's 2.0%, well short of the base's 4.2% by 2029, and fair only at about a 71% bear weight. The operating evidence is mixed but improving: AOI rose from EUR 0.63B to EUR 1.99B in the first nine months, North America's margin rose 340 bp in Q3, shipments are up 7% year to date, VCP savings are guided to double sequentially in Q4, and IFCF improved by EUR 2.4B year to date. At EUR 3.23 a share the stock is worth about 2.3x the base case's 2029 EPS and 0.17x book value excluding the hybrids. The plan does not need to be met: a recovery to 4.2% is enough for about 86% upside by 2029, while even the bear starts from EUR 42.7B of industrial liquidity, so the downside is a slow erosion of value rather than a forced recapitalization in the next two years.

catalysts.what_it_proves: Whether Q4 2026 AOI reached about EUR 1.2B (FY about 2% margin), whether FY2026 IFCF beat -EUR 4.5B, and whether 2027 guidance keeps 'positive Industrial free cash flow' despite the cost inflation the CEO flagged
catalysts.value_impact: Positive 2027 IFCF guidance with an AOI margin guide at or above the 2.3% consensus supports the base (3% or more points toward the bull) and moves 10 points from bear to bull (about +$1.3); dropping the positive-IFCF target moves 15 points from base to bear (about -$0.8)

catalysts.what_it_proves: Whether the loss-making brand gets a capital-light plan (partner, licensing or sale) or more investment
catalysts.value_impact: Small; a sale or partnership removes a drag on Enlarged Europe margins

catalysts.what_it_proves: Volume momentum from 2026 launches and North America inventory discipline (320-350k U.S. dealer units targeted for year-end 2026)
catalysts.value_impact: Revenue growth of 3% or more supports the base revenue path

catalysts.what_it_proves: The first cash test of 'positive IFCF in 2027' and the first half-year with the 2027 cost inflation in the numbers
catalysts.value_impact: H1 2027 IFCF of -EUR 1B or better with AOI margin of 2.0%+ confirms the base; IFCF below -EUR 2B triggers a kill criterion

catalysts.event: Credit rating actions (S&P BBB- negative outlook, Moody's Baa3 stable)
catalysts.timing: Any time; S&P outlook review typically within 6-24 months
catalysts.what_it_proves: Whether funding stays investment grade; a cut to junk raises the cost of EUR 56B of debt and the financial services funding
catalysts.value_impact: A junk rating is part of the bear (financing cost EUR 1.0-1.2B against EUR 0.85-0.9B in the base)

catalysts.event: Brampton plant sale to Roshel closes (subject to government and regulatory conditions)
catalysts.what_it_proves: Footprint discipline toward about 80% North America utilization in 2030

premortem.reason: Raw-material and memory-chip inflation (Oddo BHF estimates EUR 2.2B gross for 2027 alone) absorbed most of the Value Creation Program; the 2027 AOI margin stayed under 2%, IFCF stayed negative and the 2028 targets were withdrawn.
premortem.signal: 2027 guidance below a 2.0% AOI margin or without positive IFCF; Q1 2027 AOI below EUR 0.6B

premortem.reason: S&P cut Stellantis to junk in 2027; funding costs for the industrial group and Stellantis Financial Services rose, liquidity fell below the 25% target, and the board raised equity or issued more hybrids at 8%+, diluting holders at the bottom.
premortem.signal: S&P downgrade or negative watch; industrial available liquidity below 25% of TTM revenue at a quarter end; new 424B5 or hybrid issuance

premortem.reason: North America did not recover: Jeep shipments kept falling (down 60k units year over year in Q3 2026), U.S. dealer stock stayed above 90 days, incentives rose, and tariffs and the $13B U.S. investment plan held North America margins near 3%.
premortem.signal: North America AOI margin below 3% in H1 2027; U.S. dealer stock above 350k units at end-2026

premortem.reason: Europe kept losing money: Chinese competition (including partner Leapmotor's own brands) and EU CO2 rules forced price cuts, Enlarged Europe stayed negative and the 800k units of capacity cuts brought restructuring charges that the adjusted figures leave out but the cash pays.
premortem.signal: Enlarged Europe AOI margin below 0% for H1 2027; restructuring costs above EUR 1B a year

kill_criteria.condition: 2027 guidance (FY2026 results) drops the target of positive Industrial free cash flow in 2027
H1 2027 Industrial free cash flow below -EUR 2.0B
S&P or Moody's rates Stellantis below investment grade, or industrial available liquidity falls below 25% of TTM revenue at a quarter end
A common equity offering or rights issue is announced

claims.claim: Stellantis's adjusted operating income for FY2026, as reported in its FY2026 results release, is at least EUR 3.0 billion.
Stellantis's Industrial free cash flows for FY2026, as reported in its FY2026 results release, are better (less negative) than -EUR 4.5 billion.
Stellantis's Industrial free cash flows for FY2027, as reported in its FY2027 results release, are positive.
Stellantis's adjusted operating income margin for FY2027, as reported in its FY2027 results release, is at least 2.5%.
S&P Global Ratings' long-term issuer credit rating on Stellantis N.V. is BBB- or higher on December 31, 2027.
Stellantis does not announce an offering of new common shares (including a rights issue) between 2026-11-20 and 2027-12-31.

change_my_mind: More bullish: 2027 guidance with positive IFCF and an AOI margin of 3% or more despite the cost inflation, or Q4 2026 AOI above EUR 1.5B
More bullish: North America AOI margin back above 5% for a half-year, or insiders and Exor buying stock
More bearish: 2027 guidance without positive IFCF, H1 2027 IFCF below -EUR 2B, or a junk rating
More bearish: any common equity raise, or a dividend policy change that lowers the liquidity threshold to fund cash burn

base_rate.reference_class: SEC XBRL filers with over $50B starting revenue, 5-year revenue CAGR, 2009-2025 (scenario rates are 2026-2029 three-year CAGRs on 2026 consensus revenue, in euros)

next_review_trigger: FY2026 results and 2027 guidance, expected around February 25, 2027
notes: Price is the 2026-11-19 committed close. StockAnalysis shows a 2026-11-20 close of $3.34 (-5.65%), not yet in the committed series; at $3.34 the weighted value implies 23.6% a year.

Financials are IFRS in euros and the NYSE price is in dollars; every value converts at the 2026-11-19 EUR/USD close of 1.0972 and holds it constant. A 10% weaker euro by 2029 would cut every dollar value by 10%.

Adjusted net income deducts a recurring EUR 0.4-0.7B allowance for restructuring and other unusual items that the company's adjusted EPS leaves out, so base EPS (EUR 0.52 in 2027) sits below the Street's adjusted EUR 0.90 on similar AOI.
Sensitivity: each 1x of exit P/E is worth about $1.53 a share in the base (EUR 1.39 x 1.0972); each 0.5 point of 2029 AOI margin on EUR 175B is about EUR 0.22 of EPS, about $0.96 at 4x.

Exit multiples: python3 -m capital.multiples cannot compute Stellantis's own bands (IFRS facts in euros against dollar prices) and its SIC 3711 group has only GM and Ford as captured peers, so it falls back to SIC 37xx (aircraft makers). Manual checks: Stellantis traded at 2.5x 2022 EPS (EUR 5.31, $14.20 at end-2022), 3.6x 2023 EPS (EUR 5.94, $23.32 at end-2023) and 6.8x 2024 EPS (EUR 1.84, $13.05 at end-2024) at year-end EUR/USD rates of about 1.07, 1.10 and 1.04; GM's ten-year P/E median is 6.4x (p25 5.6x) and Ford's 6.7x (p25 5.6x). The 4x base and bear exits are below both peers' 10th percentiles (4.9x and 4.8x).

Hybrid perpetual notes (EUR 4.9B, March 2026) are equity under IFRS and inside industrial net cash, but rank ahead of common shares; the coupons (about EUR 0.26B after tax) are deducted from net income here, as the company does in EPS.
Employee benefit liabilities (EUR 5.0B at September 30, 2026) are carried in the base through net financial expense rather than as a separate deduction.

Street targets: the StockAnalysis aggregate (mean $6.39, low $3.92) says it was last checked November 9 and lags individual November targets (RBC and Oddo BHF at $3.29, Bank of America $3.84); the mean is probably stale on the high side.

low_score_reasons: evidence: The scenario inputs now trace to the 6-Ks, the Investor Day excerpt and the news excerpts, but the revision did not reach every file: projections/STLA.md still has the old base 2027 margin (2.5%) and bear exit (5x), the report's Weighted column adds to $6.34 instead of $6.30, the report still says a chip shortage 'halted' Fiat plants and puts a EUR 2-3B-a-year inflation figure on the CEO when the source says neither, and inputs.json's 52-week high ignores the $10.66 and $10.89 closes in the monthly series.

variant_view: The disagreement (margins recover to 3.6-4.2% in 2028-2029) can be checked, but the report and call still say the market prices '2026 earnings power held flat' and 'the bear's 2029', while the report's own reverse valuation implies an AOI margin of 2.5-3.1% (EUR 4.1-5.0B) against its 2026 estimate of 2.0% (EUR 3.22B), and the price is 2.8x the $1.25 bear value, so the market already prices some recovery; the reverse valuation also still rests on the call's own 4x.

risk: The four pre-mortem stories are distinct and the kill criteria can be tested, but the first pre-mortem signal ('2027 guidance below a 2.5% AOI margin'), the risk-table signal, the change-my-mind trigger and two catalyst readings ('2.5%+ confirms the base') were not updated when the base 2027 margin fell to 2.3%, so the main early warning fires in the modal case and cannot tell base from bear.

calibration: Revenue growth is plausible (base 2.8% a year, 43rd percentile of the over-$50B bucket), but the modal case is still +86%, with base EPS rising 2.7x from EUR 0.52 to EUR 1.39 in two years and the 2028 margin jumping 130 bp 'as inflation eases' although the CEO said the inflation runs 'in 2027, and probably also in 2028'; the claims do not match the scenarios either, since 45% for a 2027 AOI margin of at least 2.5% exceeds the 20% the weights give (only the bull reaches it).
review.counter_case: This is a Watch, not an Own. By the call's own reverse valuation, $3.54 already implies a 2.5-3.1% AOI margin held indefinitely, above the 2.0% the report estimates for 2026 and the 2.3% Visible Alpha consensus for 2027, so the market is not pricing 'no recovery'. The base then needs the margin to nearly double to 4.2% and industrial free cash flow (IFCF) to rise from zero to EUR 2.5B while the CEO says cost inflation runs through 2027 and probably 2028. The author gives only 45% to positive 2027 IFCF, the company's main near-term promise, and at 50/40/10 weights the value is $4.71 (10.0% a year, a Watch). The base's EUR 0.43 of dividends depends on liquidity staying above a 25% floor it now clears by one point (26%), industrial net cash excluding the hybrids is about EUR 0.5B, and the median of the five latest named targets is $3.84.
review.response: Second round; the first round was also a C, and its fixes (base 2027 margin at the 2.3% consensus, bear exit cut to 4x, benefit liabilities in the cash cross-check, hybrid coupons) stand. Fixed in this round: the projection now shows the 2.3% base margin, the bear at 4x, financing costs of EUR 1.0-1.2B and the -$2.33 cash value; the report's Weighted column is $0.44 / $2.97 / $2.90 = $6.30; the chip-shortage wording now says it disrupted Fiat output; the EUR 2-3B inflation figure is replaced everywhere by Oddo BHF's sourced EUR 2.2B gross for 2027; the variant view, Section 7 and Section 13 now say the price implies a 2.5-3.1% margin held indefinitely, a modest step up from 2026's 2.0% and fair only at about a 71% bear weight; the early-warning thresholds now separate base from bear (guide below 2.0% is the bear signal, at or above the 2.3% consensus supports the base, 3%+ points to the bull, H1 2027 margin 2.0%+ confirms the base); the 2.5% margin claim is cut from 45% to 35%; the Unifor item now says only that Stellantis remains prepared to negotiate, and the Brampton catalyst is the sale closing; the 52-week high is $10.89 (2025-12 month-end close). Not accepted: a Watch now. The stance follows the rule at the stated 35/45/20 weights; the 50/40/10 sensitivity ($4.71, a Watch) is in the report, the position is labeled small and high-variance, and the first kill criterion (2027 guidance dropping positive IFCF, around February 25, 2027) moves the call to Watch. The 2028 step-up to 3.6% is still below the company's 5% target for that year, and the base value sits within 2% of its own cash cross-check ($6.44).
